tonight.headline: 164.8 to 132.76 and they are finished: the first win is in
body: Bad news first, and it is all on your bench and in next week. Monday brought nothing new on Alvin Kamara's back or on Kyle Monangai's turf toe; the last word on Monangai is Saturday's (not an injured-reserve candidate, Week 6 at Atlanta the target, Yahoo/Bears Wire). Jordan Addison sat as a precaution and is expected back after the bye, not before. Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence are all off in Week 6. The good news since this morning: Carolina's coach said on Monday that Jalen Coker is 'on track' for Week 6 (SI, 17:56 UTC), and Houston called David Montgomery week-to-week (NBC, 16:29 UTC), which makes Woody Marks a real answer for your empty flex.

Los Gigantes de Teca finished at 132.76 on Sunday night. You have 164.8 and Josh Allen still to play the Rams at 18:15. He cannot lose you 32 points, so this is your first win of the season. Nothing can be changed tonight and nothing needs to be.

case.label: Why it is decided
case.body: Every one of their nine starters has played: the league file shows their live score equal to their projected-live score, 132.76. Allen is the only player left on either side, and a quarterback's worst realistic night is a few negative points, not thirty-two.

case.label: Allen tonight
case.body: Not on Buffalo's final report (sportsbettingdime, 12 Oct). Joshua Palmer is out and DJ Moore is questionable after a limited practice; Keon Coleman cleared his designation with a full practice. Inactives come out at 16:45 Mexico City, after this snapshot.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing that can happen tonight. The only open question is how many points Allen adds to a game already won.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: When the week rolls · Minnesota are on bye in Week 6
doFirst.title: Swap McLaurin in for Jefferson the moment you can
doFirst.subtitle: Jefferson is on bye next week. McLaurin played through the hamstring, came out of it unhurt, and Jayden Daniels is back throwing to him. This is not a close call; it is the slot that goes empty if nobody touches it.

case.label: Why now
case.body: Every loss in the first two weeks left points on the bench, and a bye is the easiest way to do it. Minnesota are off in Week 6: ESPN's file, FOX's bye list and Sportsnaut's Week 6 defence list (12 Oct) all agree. Your other receivers are Addison, on the same bye and held out as a precaution, and Coker, 'on track' but not yet practising.

case.label: The player
case.body: McLaurin was a game-time decision and played: 4 catches on 4 targets for 62 and the two-point conversion, no setback reported (NBC Sports, 11 Oct). Jayden Daniels started at quarterback (ESPN, 9 Oct). Diggs was inactive and nothing new was said on Monday. Washington play at San Francisco on Monday 19 Oct, against the defence Sportsnaut ranks second for Week 6, which lowers his ceiling but does not open the slot to anyone else.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Minnesota are not on bye in Week 6, which three sources say they are. Or McLaurin misses practice on Thursday and Friday with the hamstring; then the slot goes to whoever Tuesday's brief names.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · when the week rolls · Tuesday's projection picks the replacement
doFirst.title: Gordon comes out of the flex; Kamara holds it until Tuesday
doFirst.subtitle: Miami are on bye, so the flex is empty unless you fill it. Kamara is the placeholder. Since this morning Coker is 'on track' and Woody Marks has a vacancy; Tuesday's projections pick between them.

case.label: Why a placeholder
case.body: Gordon will score nothing in Week 6. Of the players who can take a flex slot here, Addison is on bye, Monangai has no date beyond Saturday's 'target Week 6', and Coker has not practised since his quad, though his coach called him 'on track' on Monday (SI, 17:56 UTC). That leaves Kamara as the only body with a Week 6 game who has been on a field lately, and a name in the slot beats an empty one.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: The five touches have a probable cause: he was questionable all week with a back injury and limited in practice (SI, 9 Oct), and CBS ties it to Miller's seven extra carries. A Monday search found nothing new from the Saints on him. Wednesday's practice report is the next evidence.

case.label: Why not more than that
case.body: Kamara had 3 carries and 2 catches. Kendre Miller took 10 carries and the touchdown and rookie CJ Donaldson led the backs in snaps, by an NBC headline; one NBC item suggests Kamara had no touches after half-time and its text would not open. He came into the game with a back injury. Until Wednesday's practice report, his Week 6 is unknown.

case.label: What Tuesday decides
case.body: Whether the flex is Kamara, Coker or Woody Marks. Houston's coach called Montgomery week-to-week on Monday (NBC, 16:29 UTC) and DraftKings Network expects him to miss London and probably Week 7 (19:12 UTC). You hold the first waiver claim; the third card covers it.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Kamara is ruled out or limited all week and this placeholder is still in your flex on Sunday; or the player Tuesday's projection prefers is left on the bench and outscores him (archive).

doFirst.sources: ESPN league file · NBC Sports · SI · CBS · AP

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · Tuesday's brief confirms · claims process Wed 01:00 Mexico City
doFirst.title: Claim Woody Marks for the Week 6 flex; the drop is Addison
doFirst.subtitle: Montgomery was called week-to-week this morning, after the 07:00 brief. Marks took every Houston carry once he left. Tuesday's projections confirm it before claims run; nothing is lost by placing it then.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: DeMeco Ryans called David Montgomery week-to-week with the groin on Monday (NBC Sports, 16:29 UTC; NFL.com roundup). DraftKings Network (19:12 UTC) expects him to miss the London game against Jacksonville and Week 7 against the Giants, with Houston's bye in Week 8. ESPN's Week 6 projection does not exist yet, so this is news it has not priced.

case.label: The player
case.body: After Montgomery left in the second quarter, no other Texans back carried: Marks finished with 15 carries for 62 and 4 catches on 4 targets, 12.5, on about half the snaps (DK Network; archive). His touches the two weeks before were 6 and 7 (wire screen). It is a two-game rental, not a new starter.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Jordan Addison, 79% rostered, and I disagree with the market on the record: he scores nothing in Week 6, Minnesota held him out as a precaution and expect him back after the bye (Bring Me The Sports, 11 Oct), and he is the third Minnesota receiver behind Jefferson and Hockenson's return. Not Monangai, whose hold thesis has not tripped; not Kamara, McLaurin or Gordon, who are exposure-protected by the wire screen; not Coker, now on track for Week 6.

case.label: Why it is a fallback today
case.body: Your flex alternatives are Kamara (back) and Coker (no practice yet). If Coker practises fully on Wednesday the gap may close, but Wednesday is after claims run. Tuesday's 16:00 brief reads ESPN's Week 6 numbers and either arms this card or kills it. You are first in a weekly-reset order, so waiting a day costs nothing.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Montgomery practises in full this week and plays in London; or whoever starts the Week 6 flex instead of Marks outscores him (archive). For the drop: Addison outscores Marks over Weeks 7 and 8 combined.

whatWentWrong.title: Kamara had five touches while playing through a back injury
whatWentWrong.lead: He was questionable all week with a back injury (SI, 9 Oct). CBS ties the back to Miller's extra carries. Nobody reported a benching.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: 3 carries for 12 and 2 catches for minus 6: 2.6 (live archive). Miller had 10 carries and the touchdown; Donaldson led the Saints' backs in snaps (NBC headline, 21:27 UTC). An NBC item filed at 21:21 UTC has an address that says he did not play in the second half and a headline that says the opposite. No recap names an injury and his coach's quoted remarks do not mention him.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: SI, before the game: questionable, limited in practice with a back injury. CBS, after it: Kendre Miller out-carried him by seven, and CBS ties that to the back. Nothing from the Saints on Monday: Kellen Moore's update named Jordyn Tyson, not Kamara (NFL.com roundup, 12 Oct). This is an explanation from reporting, not from a coach.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second and third cards. He is the placeholder in the Week 6 flex, and Woody Marks is the claim that may replace him on Tuesday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice on Wednesday makes it a quiet game. A missed one makes the flex Coker's or a claim's.

whatWentWrong.sources: NBC Sports · saints.com · Audacy · Week 5 live archive

whatWentWrong.title: Three byes hit your lineup next week
whatWentWrong.lead: Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence are all off in Week 6, and Addison with them.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Minnesota, Miami, Cincinnati and Detroit are on bye in Week 6 (ESPN file; FOX Sports list, 5 Oct). That takes two starters and the defence out of the lineup that scored 164.8 today.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Both cards: McLaurin for Jefferson, and a body for Gordon. The defence is a Tuesday claim, not a card today, because the best candidates are on waivers until Wednesday at 01:00 and you are first in the order.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing changes the byes. The flex is now a three-way choice for Tuesday (Kamara, Coker on track, or Marks on a claim) and the defence a Tuesday claim; Sportsnaut's Week 6 list (12 Oct) ranks San Francisco 2nd, Baltimore 6th and New England 8th, all on your wire.

worthALook.name: Patriots D/ST
worthALook.lead: One of three defences on your wire for the Vikings' bye. On waivers until Wednesday at 01:00, and you hold the first claim.

case.label: The matchup
case.body: New England host the Jets in Week 6. The Jets scored 17 today; Geno Smith was sacked three times in the first half and stripped once, Breece Hall has missed time and is week-to-week, and tight end Kenyon Sadiq left with a concussion (AP; newyorkjets.com). New England won 45-17.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: Scored 6 in Week 5 (live archive). Sportsnaut's Week 6 defence rankings (12 Oct) put New England 8th, behind San Francisco (2nd, home to Washington) and Baltimore (6th, at Cleveland), both also on your wire. Week 6 projections arrive on Tuesday.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No Week 6 projection exists yet. This week ESPN had New England at 6.7, tenth among defences. The others available: Baltimore, now on waivers, go to a Cleveland team that allowed eight sacks and gained under 200 yards today but themselves allowed 26 a game through Week 3; Kansas City, free, host a Chargers line missing both tackles; Atlanta, free, host Chicago, who may get Caleb Williams back.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday afternoon, from the projections. Claims run at 01:00 Mexico City on Wednesday and you are first, so nobody can take a defence on waivers from you. The seat is Tuesday's call; if the Marks claim takes Addison's, the defence needs another, and none is named today.

worthALook.sources: ESPN league file · AP · newyorkjets.com · Boston.com · CBS schedule

worthALook.name: Woody Marks
worthALook.lead: Montgomery was called week-to-week on Monday. Marks took every Houston carry once he left, and he is now the third card.

case.label: The role
case.body: Montgomery had 5 carries, left in the second quarter and did not return; no other Texans back carried (AP; 101 The Fox; Yahoo box). Marks finished with 15 carries for 62 and 4 catches on 4 targets: 12.5. His touches the two weeks before were 6 and 7 (wire screen). Houston play Jacksonville in London in Week 6.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: Monday: Ryans called Montgomery week-to-week with the groin (NBC Sports, 16:29 UTC; NFL.com). DraftKings Network (19:12 UTC) expects him to miss London and Week 7, back perhaps in Week 9 after Houston's bye. Marks played about half the snaps even before the injury.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 'Week-to-week' has no number on it. If Montgomery practises this week, Marks goes back to 6 or 7 touches. ESPN projected him 7.7 this week; the Week 6 figure arrives Tuesday.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday, from ESPN's Week 6 projections: arm the claim card if he projects above Kamara and Coker for the flex. You are first in the order and claims run Wednesday at 01:00.

worthALook.sources: NBC Sports · NFL.com · DraftKings Network · AP · wire_screen.py pass 2

worthALook.name: Stefon Diggs
worthALook.lead: On waivers until Wednesday at 01:00. Hamstring, missed all three practices, and still no timetable on Monday.

case.label: The role
case.body: Targets 6, 7 and 9 in Weeks 2 to 4 for 21.7, 7.3 and 8.5 (archive), as Washington's second receiver beside your McLaurin. Inactive today with the hamstring. Washington are off in Week 7.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: ClutchPoints and Rotoballer: hamstring, missed every practice last week, no timetable. A Monday search and NFL.com's Monday roundup carry nothing on him.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 0.0 this week and no report says when he is back or mentions injured reserve either way. He would be your sixth receiver.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday, and only with a practice on Wednesday in sight. The claim costs nothing lasting in this league, but the seat is the same one the defence needs.

worthALook.sources: AP · activity log · Week 2–4 archive · waiver_analysis.py

worthALook.name: Tre' Harris
worthALook.lead: Finished with 2 catches on 4 targets for 3.6 after being listed questionable with a hamstring. The rise was not backed up.

case.label: The role
case.body: Quentin Johnston and Brenen Thompson were inactive. Ladd McConkey was active but Schefter reported he was not expected to play meaningful snaps, and he had no targets late in the second quarter (chargers.com, 11:43; CBS gametracker). Harris had a team-high 3 targets at that point. Denver are without two starting corners.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: Live archive: 4 targets, 2 catches, 16 yards, 3.6. He was questionable with a hamstring before the game and tabbed as the WR1 with Johnston and Thompson out (Fantasy Footballers, 9 Oct). A page shows the Chargers losing 23-17 with Vidal scoring, but its date could not be confirmed.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 targets by late in the first half is not eight. He projected 9.8 and the Chargers are off in Week 7.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in the finished game and McConkey ruled out for Week 6 at Kansas City. Tuesday's brief reads the final line.

worthALook.name: 49ers D/ST
worthALook.lead: Ranked second of all defences for Week 6 by Sportsnaut, at home to Washington. On waivers until Wednesday at 01:00.

case.label: The matchup
case.body: San Francisco host Washington on Monday night, 19 Oct (Sportsnaut, 12 Oct, ranks them 2nd for Week 6). Washington tied the Giants 27-27 with a late clock error that Daniels and Quinn owned on Monday (Yahoo live page).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Linebacker Dre Greenlaw was suspended one game and is appealing, and receiver Deebo Samuel will 'miss some time' (NFL.com, 12 Oct). This week ESPN had San Francisco at 6.4, below the Patriots' 6.7. It is also the game your McLaurin plays in, so their good day is partly his bad one.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday, from ESPN's Week 6 projections: whichever of San Francisco, Baltimore and New England projects highest is the claim. The seat is Tuesday's call.

worthALook.sources: Sportsnaut · NFL.com · Yahoo · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Romeo Doubs
doNotChase.lead: This morning's watch. Hollins went on injured reserve, New England scored 45, and Doubs drew three targets.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The vacancy was real: Mack Hollins is on injured reserve. But Drake Maye threw for 374 yards and spread it: six players caught three or more, Kyle Williams led in yards, and Efton Chism and tight end Eli Raridon led in catches (Boston Globe; Boston.com; PatsFans, 11 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 targets, 1 catch, 2.6 (live archive), in the best passing game New England have had. Maye missed him once in the end zone and he drew a 27-yard interference call, which is not a target. A.J. Brown 'could be back as soon as next week' (Boston Globe).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in Week 6 with Brown still out. Until then the watch is withdrawn.

doNotChase.sources: Boston Globe · Boston.com · PatsFans · Week 5 live archive

doNotChase.name: Jets D/ST
doNotChase.lead: Sixteen points and eight sacks today, and the wrong defence for next week.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Eight sacks of Deshaun Watson, three by rookie David Bailey, a strip-sack to end the game, and Cleveland held under 200 yards (AP; newyorkjets.com). They were the best free defence this morning at 8.1, and holding the Vikings instead cost you 5.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Week 6 is at New England, who scored 45 today. The 16 came against a quarterback who completed 15 of 33.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing for Week 6. They are on waivers until Wednesday in any case.

doNotChase.sources: AP · newyorkjets.com · Boston.com · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Roman Wilson
doNotChase.lead: The biggest riser among receivers here, and now ruled out for Week 6 and expected to miss multiple weeks with the finger.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Michael Pittman Jr. went on injured reserve on Saturday, which is why managers added him. He played 20 snaps and drew one target.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Ruled out with a finger injury, reported on the broadcast as a dislocation (Steelers Depot, 14:45 ET). Rookie Germie Bernard took the work, 9 targets, and Pat Freiermuth scored twice.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full practice on Wednesday. Without it the vacancy is Bernard's, and Bernard is not on this league's published wire.

case.label: Since this morning
case.body: Jeremy Fowler (via NFL.com, 12 Oct): expected to miss multiple weeks; ruled out for Week 6 against Tampa Bay, along with Ben Skowronek (calf). Germie Bernard keeps the snaps.

doNotChase.sources: Steelers Depot · AP via Steelers Now · Week 5 live archive

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Eight targets again, and a bye next week, the week you need bodies.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 6 catches on 8 targets and a carry: 12.1 (live archive). Targets 8, 5, 10, 5, 8. No reporting on his role was found today.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Miami are off in Week 6. He cannot help the week your lineup has holes.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second straight game of eight or more after the bye, in Week 7.

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Started in London, scored, then left with a foot injury and was ruled out.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Barkley and Bigsby were out, so he started and scored from two yards.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: He left late in the second quarter with a foot injury and did not return (AP; philadelphiaeagles.com, 13:58). Dameon Pierce took over and ran 11 times for 14 yards behind a line that lost another starter.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Shipley practising on Wednesday with Barkley still out. Nobody has given a severity.

case.label: Since this morning
case.body: Partial plantar fascia tear that could sideline him multiple weeks (Schefter, via NFL.com, 12 Oct). Sirianni is hopeful Barkley returns in Week 6.

doNotChase.name: Keon Coleman
doNotChase.lead: Rising on the game DJ Moore left. He plays on Monday night and nothing has changed since Saturday.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 in Week 4 after Moore's shoulder took him out (archive). Joshua Palmer is out for Monday.

case.label: Since Sunday
case.body: He is on Buffalo's report with an ankle, status not shown, and DJ Moore is questionable (Bleacher Nation, 12 Oct). He plays tonight; nothing has changed the read.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 1, 6, 2 and 7 (archive). Moore practised on Saturday and is questionable. 8.9 projected.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Moore inactive on Monday and eight or more targets for Coleman. Tuesday's brief reads it.

case.label: Since this morning
case.body: Cleared his ankle designation after a full practice; DJ Moore is questionable (sportsbettingdime, 12 Oct). He plays tonight, after this snapshot.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar, and the bar is partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a bye, and who is now 'on track' for Week 6. Four weeks of data, still a thin sample. Nothing clears at running back or tight end; Woody Marks is a wire-screen question, not this tool's, and is the third card. None is a move today.

settled.result: Jefferson was active and scored 18.8 on 7 targets; Addison was inactive. The fallback never fired and the lineup thesis closes RIGHT.

settled.result: Dowdle was inactive for a third straight game. Warren scored 36.8 against 17.7.

settled.title: 'If Likely is ruled out: add a tight end' (the fallback carried since Wednesday)
settled.result: Never fired. Likely played and scored 32.4. Closed EXPIRED, untested.

settled.title: 'Heavy rain, an inch or so, gusts to 28 mph at Landover' (Saturday, on McLaurin and Likely)
settled.result: Three forecasts read on Sunday morning have light rain or drizzle and 8 to 12 mph. The page Saturday's figure came from could not be re-read. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'Rain showers are likely at Green Bay' (Saturday morning, in Monangai's row)
settled.result: The National Weather Service has Green Bay sunny, 75 to 79°F. The morning figure came from a site whose labels and percentages disagreed. No move rested on it.

settled.title: 'A role that may last one more game' (Saturday morning, on Doubs)
settled.result: Hollins went on injured reserve on Saturday afternoon, out at least four games. The watch stands and the wording is corrected; Brown's return is what caps it now.

settled.title: 'If Minnesota elevate Beckham, read it as doubt and no more' (Saturday morning)
settled.result: They elevated Beckham and a second receiver, Jeshaun Jones, and downgraded nobody. Still doubt and no more; the cards did not change.

settled.title: 'New England's lead receiver again with Hollins ruled out' (Friday afternoon, on Doubs)
settled.result: The Patriots' own analysis names four receivers sharing the work and says Chism took Hollins's outside role. 'Lead' was my reading of one 9-target game. The watch stands; the wording is withdrawn.

settled.title: 'Shipley and Pierce expected to share' (Friday afternoon, from the Inquirer)
settled.result: philadelphiaeagles.com, published the same afternoon, expects Shipley 'to be the primary back'. The brief used one source when the team's own was available. No move was built on it.
